claim: Cloud Backup cannot carry $100/mo recurring: it needs ~1,200 subscribers against 0. Do NOT quote 2.3% iOS conversion; corrected it is 4.0-5.9% and the gap on TOTAL revenue is ~2x, not 5x or 11x.

body.decision: DEC-340 / DAL-276 (2026-09-17). Analysis Dale autonomous; the goal change itself is Benedict's call and is with him.
body.question: Can Cloud Backup ever carry the '$100/month recurring' goal, or does the goal need a different product?
body.cloud_backup_reach_is_23_people_not_48: The ticket and DEC-252 said 48 people reached the cloud_backup paywall. 48 was an EVENT count. On person_id (the DEC-259 rule) it is 23 people across 52 events. Full trigger table, all time: manual 95/58, cloud_backup 52/23, reminders 12/11, location_limit 7/4, bulk_ops 3/2, plant_limit 3/2. Zero production sales to 23 people in 4.5 months carries close to no information.
body.the_ticket_s_own_diagnostic_is_unanswera: The plan was to split the cloud_backup reachers by whether they already held Pro, separating 'priced out by the A$50 first-year gate' from 'did not want it'. pro_source is NULL on 45 of 52 events (18 of 23 people) because the property was added later. Of the 7 that carry it: 5 events / 5 people 'none', 2 events / 1 person 'paid'. That is a sample of five and is NOT a finding.
body.cloud_backup_has_genuinely_never_sold: Checked before reporting the apparent contradiction. PostHog holds 5 cloud_backup_sub_purchased outcomes across 3 people (2026-05-11, 05-14, 05-18, 07-01). entitlement_service.dart:636 sets that outcome from the package actually bought, so they are real cloud-backup purchases, but all sit in the May internal-testing era or carry environment=sandbox. RevenueCat's sweep returns 9 purchases whose 5 sandbox rows total US$136.56 proceeds EXACTLY, matching the known sandbox set, and none of them is the cloud backup product. MRR US$0 and 0 active subscriptions stand.
body.the_conversion_rate_was_2x_too_low: DEC-261's 2.3% (3 buyers / 129 RevenueCat iOS customer records) was repeated by everything since, including DEC-335 written the same morning as this correction. DEC-334 had already measured that RevenueCat opens a customer per SDK init and roughly DOUBLES Apple's install count. We kept the numerator from Apple's side and the denominator from RevenueCat's.
body.corrected_rate: 3 of 51 Apple first-time downloads 2026-04-25..08-20 = 5.9% (Wilson 2.0-15.9%). The 4th sale, 2026-08-23, falls inside the 16-day handover hole where we hold no downloads, so the all-time rate is a RANGE of 4.0-5.9%, not a number. Not a sampling disagreement (the CIs overlap); the old denominator is measured-wrong.
body.corrected_100_per_month_arithmetic: At ~US$17.50 proceeds, $100/mo is 5.7 sales/month. At 2.3% that needed 248 iOS installs/mo (4.3x our rate); at 4.0% it needs 143 (2.5x); at 5.9% it needs 97 (1.7x). Current post-rename rate is 19 first-time downloads over 10 covered days = ~1.9/day = ~58/month. THE GAP ON TOTAL REVENUE IS ~2x, NOT 5x AND NOT 11x. Error bars are wide: n=4 sales.
body.recurring_is_not_within_an_order_of_magn: Cloud Backup at A$9.99/yr needs ~1,200 subscribers for $100/mo against 0. It requires Pro first, so it is inherently a SECOND decision, and all four buyers bought on the day they installed (lag 0,0,0,0). Nobody has ever made a second decision about this app.
body.recommendation_with_benedict: Retarget CLAUDE.md at $100/mo TOTAL revenue rather than recurring, because the one-time product is ~2x away on a lever we have just proven moves (DEC-335) and the recurring one is 1,200 subscribers away. Alternatives offered: bundle Cloud Backup into the Pro flow as a day-0 decision (his app commit, and not worth running at 23 people reached), or keep the goal as written and accept it is unreachable. DAL-276 is Todo assigned to Benedict.
body.do_not_quote: Do NOT quote 2.3% iOS conversion, '~250 iOS installs/month', or an 11x/5x gap again. Do NOT say 48 people wanted cloud backup. Do NOT open a 'fix cloud backup billing' ticket: it is configured, live on both stores, and has simply never been bought.
